description: Live Base mainnet fee snapshot. The current gas price and base fee, the block number, the base-fee window over the last 20 blocks (average, low, high) with trend and congestion labels, in wei and gwei, every card stamped with its as-of time. Descriptive network data, not trade advice. Price: $0.05 per call, paid in USDC on Base mainnet over x402; an unpaid call answers HTTP 402 with the exact machine-readable payment terms.
name: base-fee-snapshot
